Numou and Comera Financial Holding Partner to Expand Financing and Payment Solutions for UAE SMEs
summary:
Numou, a subsidiary of ADGM, and Comera Financial Holding (CFH), part of Abu Dhabi’s Royal Group, have signed a partnership agreement to expand access to financing and payment solutions for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) across the UAE.
The partnership will bring Comera Financial Holding’s financial products and services to Numou’s digital marketplace, giving SMEs access to more options for financing, business account opening and digital payments.
The collaboration draws on CFH’s broader financial services portfolio, which includes business lending through Comera Finance, digital payments and merchant solutions through Comera Pay, and supply chain finance through Comera Money.
The agreement was signed at ADGM, Abu Dhabi’s international financial centre, in the presence of H.E. Badr Al Olama, Director General of the Abu Dhabi Investment Office & Chairman of Numou. It was signed by Mohamed Al Binali, General Manager of Numou, and Akhtar Saeed Hashmi, Managing Director and Group CEO of Comera Financial Holding.
Through the partnership, SMEs will be able to access working capital and supply chain financing to purchase inventory, pay suppliers and bridge the gap between delivering goods or services and receiving payment. Business account opening and digital payment solutions will also help businesses manage their everyday financial needs.
By combining Numou’s marketplace with CFH’s financing and payments capabilities, the partnership aims to help SMEs access the financial support they need at different stages of their business growth.
“SMEs need financial solutions that support the way they do business, from purchasing stock and paying suppliers to managing payments and funding growth. This partnership expands the options available through Numou, making it easier for UAE businesses to access the services they need through one platform,” said Mohamed Al Binali, General Manager, Numou.
“SME growth depends on access to capital and the ability to put it to work. At Comera Financial Holding, we are bringing financing and payments together to support that journey—from securing an order to receiving payment. Our partnership with Numou extends this approach to more businesses across the UAE, helping them respond to opportunities with greater confidence and build for the long term,” said Akhtar Saeed Hashmi, Managing Director & Group CEO, Comera Financial Holding.

title: Visa-Mastercard payouts top $631M
summary: The tally of merchants receiving funds from a $5.5 billion settlement with the networks is nearing 700,000, according to a claims update.
content: Merchants receiving funds from a historic $5.5 billion settlement with Visa and Mastercard have been paid over $631 million so far. According to a recent claims update, the total number of merchants receiving these funds is rapidly approaching 700,000 as the payout process continues to move forward.

Navan Selected by Investec to Modernize Global Travel Program
summary:
Navan, the global AI-powered business travel and expense platform, today announced it has been selected by Investec, a leading international bank and wealth manager, to upgrade its global travel program.
“As Investec continues its digital transformation, we’re excited to partner with an AI-first travel platform to increase adoption and improve operational efficiency,” said Lyndon Subroyen, Investec Group Chief Technology and Operating Officer.
As a dual-listed company in the United Kingdom and South Africa, Investec sought a partner to consolidate its travel operations, reduce administrative work, and improve the booking experience for its workforce. Investec needed a solution to increase platform adoption and help employees travel more cost-efficiently.
Key Anticipated Benefits:
Higher adoption by providing access to Navan's inventory, which includes more than 600 airlines, over 2 million lodging properties, and major rail and rental-car providers.
Operational efficiencies through automated reconciliation that saves finance teams time and gives them accurate, real-time visibility.
Cost savings through increased adoption, access to expanded inventory, and improved policy compliance.
“Navan is proud to help Investec modernize its global travel program,” said Zahir Abdelouhab, SVP, Enterprise Sales, EMEA, Navan. “This will be a lighthouse account in the banking sector, and when an organization as respected and influential as Investec puts this kind of focus on the travel experience, it sends a strong signal to the rest of the industry.”
Navan continues to build on its momentum in financial services, serving nearly 1,500 financial institutions globally, a 36% increase year over year in FY2026. Financial services companies are also increasing their investment in business travel: for the 12 months ended August 31, 2026, flight bookings were up 12%, hotel bookings were up 9%, and expense transaction volume was up 7% year over year. Navan serves multinational financial services companies and fintechs such as Visa, Paysafe, and Block.

content: Investec has selected Navan, an AI-powered business travel and expense platform, to modernize and upgrade its global travel program. The partnership aims to consolidate travel operations, increase platform adoption, reduce administrative burdens, and improve operational efficiencies and cost savings for Investec's workforce across the United Kingdom and South Africa.
